import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Query the coordinates of Causeway Bay station
query_station_coords = text("""
SELECT coordinate
FROM air_quality_station
WHERE id = 17
""")
station_coords = pd.read_sql(query_station_coords, engine)
station_coords = station_coords.iloc[0, 0]

# Query the road segments within 300 meters of Causeway Bay station
query_road_segments = text(f"""
SELECT rs.id AS road_segment_id, rs.geometry
FROM road_segment rs
WHERE ST_DWithin(rs.geometry::geography, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint({station_coords[0]}, {station_coords[1]}), 4326)::geography, 300)
""")
road_segments = pd.read_sql(query_road_segments, engine)

# Query the hourly NO2 values for Causeway Bay station in June 2025
query_no2 = text("""
SELECT datetime
FROM hourly_station_air_quality
WHERE station_id = 17
AND datetime >= '2025-06-01 00:00:00'
AND datetime < '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
AND no2 > 100
""")
no2_hours = pd.read_sql(query_no2, engine)

# Query the congestion indices for the road segments during the NO2 > 100 hours
query_congestion = text(f"""
SELECT hrt.road_segment_id, AVG(hrt.congestion_index) AS mean_congestion_index
FROM hourly_road_segment_traffic hrt
JOIN ({no2_hours.to_sql(index=False, name='no2_hours', con=engine, if_exists='temp', dtype={'datetime': 'TIMESTAMP'})}) no2_hours ON hrt.datetime = no2_hours.datetime
WHERE hrt.road_segment_id IN ({', '.join(map(str, road_segments['road_segment_id']))})
GROUP BY hrt.road_segment_id
""")
congestion_indices = pd.read_sql(query_congestion, engine)

# Find the road segment with the highest mean congestion index
worst_segment = congestion_indices.loc[congestion_indices['mean_congestion_index'].idxmax()]
worst_segment_id = worst_segment['road_segment_id']
worst_segment_ci = round(worst_segment['mean_congestion_index'], 2)

worst_segment_id, worst_segment_ci
